title: StreetComplete on iOS is now in public beta
why_read: A niche but useful update for an open-source mapping/OSM contribution app reaching iOS, relevant mainly to OSM contributors and mobile open-source fans.
analysis: StreetComplete is a well-known open-source Android app that gamifies improving OpenStreetMap data by asking users simple yes/no or multiple-choice questions about their surroundings. This item reports that the app is now in public beta on iOS, closing a long-standing platform gap. It's a solid piece of open-source and civic-tech news but technically narrow in scope, mostly interesting to OSM contributors and mobile developers curious about cross-platform rewrites.
